<function name="ShouldDropOnDie" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>
Should this weapon be dropped when its owner dies?

This only works if the player has <page>Player:ShouldDropWeapon</page> set to true.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to drop the weapon, false otherwise. Default ( if you don't return anything ) is false.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
